title: Wallet top-ups failing
alert: Lock wait timeout exceeded on ledger_entries; wallet top-ups failing
root cause: The month-end reconciliation job ran on the primary database and locked ledger_entries
fix: Killed the reconciliation job and moved it to the read replica

title: Customers charged twice
alert: Duplicate debits reported; card 4539 8812 0093 2211, customer phone 9988776655
root cause: Checkout retried after a gateway timeout without an idempotency key, so the charge ran twice
fix: Added an idempotency key on transaction id and auto-reversed the duplicate charges

title: eKYC verification timing out
alert: kyc-service vendor timeouts at 35%; customer vikram.t@outlook.com stuck at onboarding
root cause: The eKYC vendor lowered our rate limit and requests above it hung until timeout
failed fixes: Increasing the vendor timeout to 60 seconds
fix: Added a token-bucket queue at the new vendor limit and retried queued verifications

title: UPI collect requests timing out
alert: HikariPool-1 connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms. p99 latency 8.2s
root cause: A long finance report query held connections on the primary during a cashback campaign, exhausting the pool
failed fixes: Restarting payments-api pods (timeouts returned within minutes)
fix: Moved the finance report to the read replica and killed the long-running sessions

title: OTP delivery dropped
alert: otp-service delivery_rate=62%, sms-gateway-a responding 429 Too Many Requests
root cause: A marketing push during the salary-day peak used the same SMS route as OTPs and gateway A throttled us
failed fixes: Bulk-retrying failed OTPs (made the throttling worse)
fix: Failed over OTP traffic to sms-gateway-b and resumed the campaign in batches

title: Settlement file upload failed
alert: SFTP authentication failed uploading the settlement file to ICICI; merchant payouts delayed
root cause: ICICI rotated its SFTP host key and our client rejected the new fingerprint
failed fixes: Retrying the upload repeatedly (locked the SFTP account)
fix: Bank ops unlocked the account, we added the new host fingerprint and re-uploaded the file
